headline: Sealed non-public minutes from the annual evaluation of the Superintendent of Schools.
summary: The meeting was held for the annual evaluation of the Superintendent of Schools. It went into non-public session under RSA 91-A:3II (a) and then returned to public session. Members then voted to seal the non-public minutes.
decisions: Approved sealing the non-public minutes under RSA 91-A3III (i) by a 6-0 roll call vote, with three members absent.

decision_evidence.quote: Ms. Bishop moved, seconded by Ms. Prinn, to seal the non-public minutes under RSA 91-A3III (i). ... So voted by roll call at 6:43 pm.

SPECIAL BOARD OF EDUCATION 
MONDAY, AUGUST 3, 2026 
NHS NORTH BOARD ROOM 
 
A special meeting of the Board of Education was held at NHS North on Monday, August 3, 2026.  Ms. Bishop 
called the meeting to order at 6:06 pm. 
 
Present: Ms. Giglio (via phone), Ms. Prinn, Mr. Johnson, Ms. Raymond, Ms. Lamphier, and Ms. Bishop 
 
Also Present: Michael Bowse, Director of Human Resources 
 
 
The purpose of this Special BOE meeting is the annual evaluation of the Superintendent of Schools . 
 
 
Ms. Bishop moved, seconded by Ms. Prinn, to enter non-public session at 6:07 pm under RSA 91-A:3II (a).

Ms. Bishop moved, seconded by Ms. Prinn, to seal the non-public minutes under RSA 91-A3III (i).
